metadata.title: Controls — Nebula
metadata.description: Default buttons, pointer controls and the devices supported by v2.

page.paragraph_2: Default buttons, pointer controls and the devices supported by v2.
page.paragraph_3: These instructions cover the upcoming update. The current public download is v1.0.2.

defaults.paragraph_1: Use keyboard and mouse, a controller, or a real Wii Remote with Nunchuk. The controller layout follows Super Mario Galaxy on Switch, with Star Bits on the left shoulder and a dedicated spin button.
defaults.column_8: Jump in play, back in menus
defaults.cell_11: Left Shift, Right Shift, right mouse button
defaults.cell_28: X, Y, ZR, shake the controller
defaults.cell_38: D-pad; right stick while the gyro points
defaults.cell_43: Gyro; right stick when the gyro is off
defaults.paragraph_2: On controllers, B / Circle is jump during play and Back in menus. Use LB / L / L1 to shoot Star Bits.

motion.item_1: The mouse aims the pointer. On Xbox, use the right stick.
motion.item_2: Supported PlayStation, Switch and Steam controllers can aim with the gyro. Turn gyro off to use the right stick for the pointer.
motion.item_3: Use the recenter button to bring the pointer back to the middle.
motion.item_4: Shake a motion-capable controller to spin, or use a mapped spin button.
motion.item_5: Tilt controls steer the Star Ball and ray surfing sections. Keyboard and Xbox controls use movement inputs instead.
motion.item_6: Adjust pointer speed, sensitivity, dead zones and vibration in Controls.

devices.cell_1: USB, Bluetooth or the Xbox wireless adapter.
devices.cell_2: DualShock 4, DualSense and DualSense Edge over USB or Bluetooth; gyro supported.
devices.cell_3: USB or Bluetooth, with gyro and HD Rumble.
devices.cell_4: USB; Windows may require an additional driver. Check the v2 release instructions. Bluetooth is not supported.
devices.cell_5: Pair a left and right half in Bluetooth settings. v2 combines them as one controller.
devices.cell_6: Native controls and supported motion inputs. Platform downloads have separate availability.
devices.cell_7: Xbox mode, Switch mode or generic mode; remap if needed.
devices.cell_8: Buttons and sticks can be remapped. Vibration is not supported for generic HID pads.
devices.cell_9: Pair in Bluetooth settings. Pointer setup depends on a sensor bar; final pairing instructions will accompany v2.

remapping.paragraph_1: Open Controls in the launcher or the game. Choose the connected device and select an action. Add up to four inputs for each Wii input, or clear an existing binding. Profiles are stored per controller family.
remapping.paragraph_2: Open settings with F1, View + Menu, Share + Options or Minus + Plus. Use Apply to keep changes. General → Button icons lets you choose a fixed button style instead of following the current controller.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
